Mina (Head of Eng Processes): Leaving a short follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about release cadence, oncall experiments, quality bars, and SLA details. Use this thread for quick clarifications and action items.

Cal (VP Eng): TL;DR: aim for predictable 3-week major cycle, weekly minor windows, and an ops-approved fast-path for urgent fixes.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Quick ask: can we get a "release-ready" PR checklist snippet to drop into PR templates? Small teams keep missing rollback verification.

Rex (SRE Lead): Minimal checklist proposal: CI green, smoke tests pass, rollback tested (dry-run), canary plan with rollback point, and runbook link. I'll paste a 5-line template in the releases repo.

Pri (Product): Product wants a one-line rule for "major" vs "minor" for PMs labeling changes. Something we can include in the release doc.

Mina (Head of Eng Processes): Suggestion: major = API contract change, model weights, or DB migration; minor = config, infra, perf tuning that doesn't change contracts. Short and actionable.

Jordan (Eng Manager): On oncall: teams asked to go from 3w -> 2w primary. Ops worried about more handover noise. Any compromise?

Rex (SRE Lead): Compromise: 2w primary + 1w overlap (shadow). Outgoing primary is reachable for questions but not first pager. We'll pilot with runtime and api-platform.

Cal (VP Eng): Pilot for one quarter. We'll measure: pages during handover, average ack time, and number of handover follow-ups. If noise rises >25% revert.

Pri (Product): On quality bars: PMs worry about noisy eval alerts blocking releases. What thresholds should trigger a block vs a warning?

Rex (SRE Lead): Initial thresholds (tunable per model family): block if golden-set relevance drops >4% relative OR hallucinations increase >5% absolute OR 95p latency regresses >10%. Warnings below those. Alerts go to model owner + release lead.

Mina (Head of Eng Processes): Escalation timeline question: if a release is blocked, what's the response SLA?

Rex (SRE Lead): Protocol: acknowledge within 4 business hours for P1 block, mitigation plan within 24 hours. If unresolved after 48 hours, release lead + product + reliability make a decision. We'll add this flow to the runbook.

qa-bot: Reminder: add "release-ready" checklist snippet to PR templates: https://redwood.internal/releases/templates (auto)

Jordan (Eng Manager): Action items: @Rex to PR pilot schedule + overlap checklist by EOW; @Mina to draft the one-pager with major/minor rules and escalation flow; @Cal to publish the pilot metrics and rollback criteria.

Cal (VP Eng): Please drop exceptional cases here (cross-service migrations, heavy-data backfills, infra-only hotfixes). We'll fold them into the one-pager.

Mina (Head of Eng Processes): Thanks all. Short thread; will close after the PRs land and the one-pager is drafted. :thumbsup:
